systems.owner: ANIP, implementing agency for Benin under the World Bank's WURI Phase 2 (P169594)
systems.tiers: national; operational, 2,253,000 persons registered and UNIs delivered to 5,526,376 direct beneficiaries at 10 February 2025; rated only partially aligned with international good practice; 864,735 digital authentications a month

systems.system: Assignment of UNIs to newborn birth registrations
systems.tiers: the World Bank reports 100% of births assigned temporary UNIs, at 15 December 2023 and again at 10 February 2025, against a target of 80%

systems.system: Links from services to the fID system
systems.tiers: at least 19 services at 10 February 2025: all government services, Alafia microcredit, Gbessoke, Cash + Care, mobile money and SIM registration

note: A World Bank status report on the identity project; it records a 2018 ID law and a 2021 civil registration law as adopted and that registered births receive a temporary unique number, and says nothing of how or where births are recorded.
